model_name: CLASS_EDE axion-like scalar-field Early Dark Energy

branch.potential: m^2 f^2 [1-cos(phi/f)]^n plus separately tuned CC in CLASS_EDE units
branch.reference: pure LambdaCDM in same CLASS_EDE commit

diagnostic_run_1.cause: missing six-entry scf_parameters seed required by CLASS_EDE shooting-guess code

stage_A.interpretation: Stable early/scale response with nearly null late-time H in this tested branch.

stage_B.interpretation: The full local CPL manifold fails to absorb the M10 EDE direction in the frozen same-solver theory-response comparison. The huge relative H residual reflects an almost-null EDE H target versus non-negligible H induced by the CPL combination, and must not be interpreted as an absolute signal-to-noise measure.

primary_question_result: YES in unwhitened same-solver theory-response space: the stable EDE direction remains substantially outside the full local CPL manifold in P/H/S, unlike M07 quintessence.
next_hard_question: Does this early/shape separator survive a genuine common observation operator/covariance that admits early transfer-shape information, and is it robust to CPL finite-difference step and alternative early-time comparators?
anti_overclaim: M10 is distinct from blocked M09 native CLASS EDE.
B6 is a theory-response same-solver discriminator, not observational detection.
The very large relative H residual is caused by the near-null EDE H denominator and is not an absolute significance.
The S-only projection is diagnostic and cannot replace the preregistered shared P+H fit.
No finite Stage A point is a prospective holdout.
